name: 37307-longisl-8b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One engine, one GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=100, no warmup, no cooldown, bound 100 requests, 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, exactly 40000 prompt tokens and exactly 1000 output tokens per request, no shared prefix, ignore_eos true, temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, request_format plain (raw completions, no chat template).
purpose: A long-document analysis service on one GPU, with an 8B model reading 40,000-token submissions for 100 concurrent users.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Not one token of slack, and a tripwire rather than a tuning knob: the prompt is sent as text and
# this tokenizer prepends <|begin_of_text|>, so 40001 + 1000 generated = 41001 exactly. Trimming
# this to 41000 would refuse every request in the item.
max-model-len: 41001

enable-chunked-prefill: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 128
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
